user.title: Connect to RepRapFirmware
user.description: Configure a standalone RepRapFirmware printer. The connection and machine password are validated before the entry is created.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the RepRapFirmware controller.
data_description.port: HTTP or HTTPS port exposed by the controller.
data_description.use_ssl: Connect to the controller using HTTPS.
data_description.password: RepRapFirmware machine password. Leave blank only if the machine does not require one.
data_description.name: Name shown for this printer in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: The RepRapFirmware machine password is invalid.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the RepRapFirmware connection.

abort.already_configured: This RepRapFirmware endpoint is already configured.

send_gcode.name: Send G-code
send_gcode.description: Send arbitrary G-code to a RepRapFirmware printer. This is an advanced machine-control action.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: RepRapFirmware printer that will receive the command.

gcode.name: G-code
gcode.description: G-code command or commands to submit to RepRapFirmware.

run_macro.name: Run macro
run_macro.description: Run a discovered RepRapFirmware macro on the selected printer.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: RepRapFirmware printer that will run the macro.

macro.name: Macro
macro.description: Discovered macro filename, for example Delta Calibration.g.

command_not_allowed.message: This command is not available while the printer state is {state}.

invalid_device_id.message: No RepRapFirmware device was found with ID {device_id}.

config_entry_not_loaded.message: The RepRapFirmware printer is not currently loaded.

macro_not_found.message: The RepRapFirmware macro {macro} is not currently discovered.

init.title: Object Model entities
init.description: Expose additional scalar RepRapFirmware Object Model paths as Home Assistant entities.

add_object_model_entity.title: Add Object Model entity
add_object_model_entity.description: Configure a scalar RepRapFirmware Object Model path. Arrays and objects are not supported.

data_description.path: RepRapFirmware Object Model key, for example global.fsRunoutSeq or sensors.gpIn[3].value.
data_description.name: Name shown for the entity in Home Assistant.
data_description.entity_type: Expose the value as a sensor or binary sensor.
data_description.unit: Optional unit for sensor entities. Ignored for binary sensors.
data_description.invert: Invert true/false for binary sensors. Ignored for normal sensors.

error.invalid_object_model_config: The Object Model entity configuration is invalid.
error.object_model_path_exists: This Object Model path is already configured.
error.cannot_read_object_model_path: Unable to read this Object Model path from RepRapFirmware.
error.object_model_value_not_scalar: This Object Model path returns an array or object. Only scalar values are supported.
error.object_model_value_not_binary: The current value cannot be interpreted as a binary value.
error.object_model_value_is_boolean: This path currently returns a Boolean. Configure it as a binary sensor.

abort.object_model_limit_reached: The maximum number of configured Object Model entities has been reached.
abort.no_object_model_entities: There are no configured Object Model entities to remove.
